svg.text: The four steps (the current one in bold) and what was read: samples, sheets, channels.
Add files: more samples of the same kind; ✕ next to a sample removes it.
Data kind: what the curves are. The wizard guesses it from the file and says from which cell.
Origin: simulation or a measurement processed elsewhere. The file cannot tell; the red star means unanswered.
Values: linear or in dB (then with the reference level).
Amplitude in the file: Peak, RMS, Peak-to-Peak, or From the header when the header says it.
Channel type: Automatic follows the unit; pick one to override it.
Why Next is off: the answers still missing.
Next (Alt+Right) goes on once everything is answered; Back is Alt+Left.
